findings: The company reports that its FinShare platform serves over 50,000 clients across more than 100 countries and processes over 30 million monthly transactions.

Publicly announced deployments verify that the company's platform has been rolled out across multiple Tier-1 and regional financial institutions, including expanding SMBC's supply chain finance solutions across nine global regions in 2024, building an automated end-to-end workflow system for Thailand's Krungthai Bank, and powering HNB's TxB ValueX platform launched in May 2026.

The evaluation rests on verified large-scale regional deployments with major financial institutions like SMBC, Krungthai Bank, and HNB, alongside self-reported data indicating a substantial customer transaction volume and global client footprint.
